The '''NearMe''' extension provides '''Special:Nearby''' for finding wiki pages near a geographic coordinate, using {{ll|Extension:Cargo}} {{ll|Extension:Cargo/Data_types#Coordinates|Coordinates}} fields and Cargo's <code>NEAR</code> SQL query. It exposes <code>action=cargonearby</code> for the same search from JavaScript or external tools.

NearMe is a Cargo-native alternative to {{ll|Extension:NearbyPages|NearbyPages}}, which depends on {{ll|Extension:GeoData|GeoData}}. Do not enable both NearMe and NearbyPages if they register the same special page name.

Developed for [https://saintapedia.org/ Saintapedia].

== Special:Nearby ==

The special page requests the user's location (with permission), or accepts manual coordinates in the URL hash, for example:

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
https://example.org/wiki/Special:Nearby#/coord/40.4406,-79.9959
</syntaxhighlight>

Results are distance-sorted pages from the configured Cargo tables. Optional example links (configured in <code>MediaWiki:NearMe-config</code>) let users try a fixed location without GPS.

<code>Special:NearMe</code> is a deprecated alias for the same page (bookmarks only).

== Installation ==

{{ExtensionInstall
|NearMe
|registration=required
|custom-steps=* Install and enable {{ll|Extension:Cargo|Cargo}} first.
* Cargo tables must include at least one field of type Coordinates.
* Create <code>MediaWiki:NearMe-config</code> (preferred) or set <code>$wgNearMeTables</code> in LocalSettings.php.
}}

Clone from GitHub:

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
cd extensions/
git clone https://github.com/Saintapedia/NearMe.git NearMe
</syntaxhighlight>

Add to <code>LocalSettings.php</code> '''after''' Cargo:

<syntaxhighlight lang="php">
wfLoadExtension( 'Cargo' );
wfLoadExtension( 'NearMe' );
</syntaxhighlight>

Optional: install {{ll|Extension:Maps|Maps}} for the Leaflet results map (<code>ext.NearMe.maps</code> module).

== Configuration ==

=== MediaWiki:NearMe-config (preferred) ===

Create a JSON page at <code>MediaWiki:NearMe-config</code> (wrap in <code>&lt;pre&gt;</code> if you like). Each Cargo source needs <code>table</code>, <code>coordField</code>, and <code>label</code> (friendly name for tabs and the search button). Optional per source: <code>labelField</code> (row display; defaults to wiki page title), <code>default</code> (pre-selected tab).

<syntaxhighlight lang="json">
{
  "defaultRadius": 10000,
  "defaultLimit": 50,
  "sources": [
    {
      "table": "Places",
      "coordField": "Coordinates",
      "label": "Places"
    }
  ],
  "examples": [
    {
      "label": "Philadelphia, PA",
      "lat": 39.9526,
      "lon": -75.1652
    }
  ]
}
</syntaxhighlight>

When this page exists, it takes precedence over <code>$wgNearMeTables</code>.

=== LocalSettings.php ===

; <code>$wgNearMeTables</code>
: Fallback array of Cargo sources when <code>MediaWiki:NearMe-config</code> is absent. Each entry needs <code>table</code>, <code>coordField</code>, and <code>label</code>; <code>labelField</code> is optional.
; <code>$wgNearMeConfigPage</code>
: MediaWiki page name for JSON config. Default: <code>NearMe-config</code>. Set to empty string to disable wiki config.
; <code>$wgNearMeIntroPage</code>
: Optional MediaWiki page with wikitext above the app. Default: empty (no intro).
; <code>$wgNearMeDefaultRadius</code>
: Default search radius in metres. Default: <code>10000</code> (10 km).
; <code>$wgNearMeMaxRadius</code>
: Maximum allowed radius in metres. Default: <code>50000</code>.
; <code>$wgNearMeDefaultLimit</code>
: Default maximum number of results. Default: <code>50</code>.
; <code>$wgNearMeMaxLimit</code>
: Hard cap on results per request. Default: <code>100</code>.

== API ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
GET /api.php?action=cargonearby&format=json&gscoord=40.4406|-79.9959&gsradius=10000&gslimit=50
</syntaxhighlight>

Optional <code>table</code> parameter limits the search to one configured Cargo table.
